decisions.reason: The rye country bread is a core everyday item made with established recipes and production, so it meets aspirations at low cost and gives no reason for problemistic search.
The premium raisin stollen is the flagship and has repeatedly won gold medals, so its results clearly exceed aspirations and dropping it is very unlikely.
The seeded rye mixed bread fits the established bread range and uses existing resources, and there is no sign of a shortfall that would justify dropping it.
The dark malt rye bread is a niche variant that could be cut if the range is pruned again after Product F was withdrawn, but it runs on the existing line and slack lets the firm carry it.
The marzipan stollen complements the award-winning stollen line in the seasonal gift assortment and costs little to keep alongside the flagship.
